id.description: Stable identifier. Never renamed once released: house views point to it.

i18n.description: Text per language (BCP-47 short tag). English is mandatory and used as fallback.

icon.description: Material Design Icon shown in the lists when there is no picture.

keywords.description: Words that name this entry in a Sweet Home 3D plan, in any language (lower case, no accent): a piece of furniture whose name holds one of them is drawn with this entry.

bounded_length.description: A length in metres: the usual one, and the bounds a user may choose within.

scatter.description: Small coloured dots (flowers, fruits, fallen leaves) and how much of the surface they cover.

amount.description: Share of the surface covered: just above 0 (a few) to 1 (everywhere).

rendering.description: How a tree looks during one season.

foliage.description: Colour of the leaves or needles.

density.description: Share of the full foliage: 1 fills the crown, 0 leaves bare branches.

fruits.description: Fruits (or cones, berries) on the crown.

fallen.description: Leaves, petals or needles on the ground under the crown.

part.description: A solid of an object. x is the width, y the height, z the depth, in metres; the object stands on the ground, centred on its footprint, its front toward +z.

shape.description: box, cylinder (upright, as wide and deep as given), sphere (an ellipsoid of the three sizes) or cone (upright, point up).

x.description: Centre of the part along x.

z.description: Centre of the part along z.

elevation.description: Height of the bottom of the part above the ground, before any rotation.

yaw.description: Rotation about the vertical axis, in degrees, about the centre of the part (positive turns the front toward +x).

pitch.description: Rotation about the width axis, in degrees (positive leans the top toward the front).

roll.description: Rotation about the depth axis, in degrees (positive leans the top toward -x).

tint.description: Painted with the colour chosen for the object when it is placed; the colour above is then its default one.

tree_variety.description: A variety of a tree: the colours of its blossom and its fruits (a red, a yellow or a green apple).

flowers.description: Colour of the blossom, in every season that has some.

fruits.description: Colour of the fruits, in every season that has some.

fish_variety.description: A colour variety: the colour of the body, then patches over it, in order.

belly.description: Colour of the flanks and of the belly, when it differs from the back.

fins.description: Colour of the fins (the colour of the body by default).

patches.description: Patches over the body, drawn in order (the later ones over the earlier ones).

fish_patch.description: Patches of one colour on the back.

amount.description: Share of the back covered: just above 0 (a touch) to 1 (all of it).

size.description: Size of each patch: small spots, medium patches or large ones.

where.description: anywhere on the back, only on the head (a round spot for one patch: tancho), or on the back behind the head.
